description: PII detector and redactor: finds emails, phone numbers, payment cards (Luhn), IBANs, Aadhaar (Verhoeff), Indian PAN, US SSN, UK NI numbers, Nepal citizenship numbers, passports, dates of birth, IP and wallet addresses in text or a URL; masked findings with positions, optional redacted copy with stable placeholders. Use before logging, storing, summarising or sending text to a third-party model, or to check what personal data a document, transcript or tool result contains. Pass text or url, redact: true for a copy with each value replaced by a placeholder like [EMAIL_1] (same value, same placeholder), and types[] to limit what is reported. Returns found, count, severity, findings[] {type, category (contact, financial, government-id, personal, network), severity, confidence, masked, placeholder, line, column, detail}, byType, byCategory, summary and redacted. Names and street addresses are not detected. Nothing is stored. Price: $0.002 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls.

redact.description: Also return `redacted`: the text with every value replaced by its placeholder, e.g. [EMAIL_1], [CARD_1], [PHONE_2] (default false)

text.description: Text to scan: a transcript, document, form, log, CSV or tool output (up to 2,000,000 characters)

types.description: Only report these types: email, phone, credit-card, iban, aadhaar, india-pan, us-ssn, uk-nino, nepal-citizenship, passport, date-of-birth, ip-address, crypto-address (default all)

url.description: Public URL to fetch and scan instead of text

name: scan_pii

category.description: contact, financial, government-id, personal or network

detail.description: Card brand, IBAN country, phone country, private/public IP, evm/bitcoin

type.description: email, phone, credit-card, iban, aadhaar, india-pan, us-ssn, uk-nino, nepal-citizenship, passport, date-of-birth, ip-address or crypto-address

redacted.description: Present when redact was true; first 200,000 characters

url.description: Present when a url was fetched

title: PII detector and redactor
